item.title: U.S.-China biotech investment barriers miss the real threat: domestic R&D stagnation.
item.description: Restricting outbound investment in Chinese biotech won't protect U.S. competitiveness if we keep underfunding domestic basic research while licensing their molecules to fill our pipelines.

item.title: Physicists Pivot to Ultralight Dark Matter Experiments as WIMP Searches Fail to Yield Results
item.description: With traditional WIMP searches hitting a wall, the dark matter hunt is turning into a masterclass in precision metrology, using everything from thorium nuclear clocks to Earth's ionosphere.

item.title: FDA's shifting cell and gene therapy stance sparks industry clash before recent reset
item.description: The FDA's brief push for rigid placebo controls in ultra-rare gene therapies shows how fast agency leadership turnover can disrupt regulatory predictability for biotech pipelines.

item.title: AI CEOs Clash Over Whether Humans Should Cede Control to Superintelligence
item.description: The clash shows that while some AI leaders see handing over critical decisions to superintelligence as inevitable, others fear it could trigger backlash and ethical fallout, shaping the future regulatory landscape.

item.title: Ambetter’s Prior‑Authorization Denials Outpace ACA Peers, Delaying Critical Care
item.description: Ambetter’s unusually high prior‑authorization denial rates are forcing patients to fight insurers just to get standard cancer treatments, and the system barely lets anyone appeal.

item.title: China Leverages Trump‑Era Détente to Build a Higher Baseline Before Inevitable Competition
item.description: China is locking in trade and diplomatic wins now to ensure a stronger hand when U.S.–China relations inevitably turn more competitive again.

item.title: Vyriad’s Low‑Profile Strategy Secures Big‑Pharma Partnerships for In‑Vivo CAR‑T
item.description: Vyriad shows that a quiet, science‑first approach can attract big‑pharma partners and advance in‑vivo CAR‑T therapies for cancer.

item.title: AI vulnerability discovery surge drives patching chaos, not necessarily attacks
item.description: The recent tech outages aren't necessarily hacks, but the side effect of AI finding four times as many bugs as before, forcing defenders into a chaotic patching race.

item.title: How M.F.K. Fisher’s grief fueled a culinary classic
item.description: It’s a fascinating case study in how creative output can serve as a psychological coping mechanism for severe grief, turning personal tragedy into a cultural touchstone for culinary writing.

item.title: Kodak Reports Fifth Straight Quarter of Growth, Driven by Advanced Materials Unit
item.description: Kodak’s shift to analog shows how niche markets can drive profitability even in a digital age.
